prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1447; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a low-speed collision in a retail parking lot. Insured reports the other vehicle backed into the insured's rear bumper. Police report not filed; both parties exchanged information at the scene. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel. Representation letter received and acknowledged. All further communication to be routed through the attorney's office. Claimant reports neck strain from the impact and has begun treatment with a chiropractor.

Entry 3: Insured's vehicle inspected by appraiser. Visible damage limited to rear bumper cover and tail light assembly. Repair estimate received and under review. No structural damage noted in the appraisal.

Entry 4: Attorney's office requested the claim file and medical authorization forms. Forms sent to counsel for signature. Treatment records requested from the chiropractor and primary care provider once authorization is returned.

Entry 5: Liability position reviewed. Parking lot surveillance footage requested from the property owner but not yet received. Claim remains open pending medical records, repair finalization, and response from claimant's counsel on settlement posture.
